name: Mega Phoenix
doc: Mega Phoenix (battle item; the actor/heal library's act family, Mega-Potion's kind): one emitter per target in turn, each running an actor system whose actor data defines its particle actors (flipbooks and prim models placed by the caster and its target); the revive; the stage fading in and out. No camera track.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data"); the actor data whole, its pointers moved to the copy.

actors.doc: The actor data: the header of its 4 tables of 16 (the actor definitions, their models, sequences and vertex blocks) and, below it from body, what they point at

act.doc: The act family's master: once its children are gone, the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared, the stage fade in; after the last target its wait, the fade out

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per target of the action, in turn: the actor system, the master's release, the revive, its sound (draws nothing)

parts.title: Actors
parts.doc: The actor system: the engine's particle actors its actor data defines, placed by the caster and the target

parts.title: Stage fades
parts.doc: The stage's fade layers: up while the effect plays, down after (draws nothing itself)

parts.title: Actor 0
parts.doc: Definition 0 of the actor data: the morphing ring model (its emitter and its particles)

parts.title: Actor 1
parts.doc: Definition 1 of the actor data: the rising ring models (its emitter and its particles)

parts.title: Actor 2
parts.doc: Definition 2 of the actor data: the rings climbing the path (its emitter and its particles)

parts.title: Actor 3
parts.doc: Definition 3 of the actor data: the sparkles up to the target (its emitter and its particles)

parts.title: Actor 5
parts.doc: Definition 5 of the actor data: the sparks bursting up (its emitter and its particles)

groups.label: Fade in
groups.doc: Once the master's children are gone: the level up by Step a tick, to Level

groups.label: Fade out
groups.doc: After the last target: from Level down by Step a tick, to 0

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played at its first tick (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Next target at tick
params.doc: The master starts the next target's emitter when this one's tick == this

params.label: Revive from tick
params.doc: Its target revived (the action's result) from this tick

params.label: Start tick
params.doc: The actor system starts when its own tick reaches this

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: It spawns its actors for this many ticks, then ends once they are gone

params.label: Mode
params.doc: Where it takes its reference points: 0 the caster's bones, 2 none, 1 / 3 / 4 their extra set-ups

params.label: Skipped definitions
params.doc: Bit k set: definition k spawns nothing

params.label: Fade out after
params.doc: Ticks after the last target's emitter released the master

params.label: Placement
params.doc: Where its emitter sits: 0 a point of its target, 1 a point of the caster, 2 its owner's position, 3 following its owner, 4 along a path (its per-frame tables)

params.label: Point
params.doc: Placements 0 / 1: 0 the ground under it, 1 its bone 0xF1, 2 its bone 0xF0, 3 its height point

params.label: Facing
params.doc: Its emitter's matrix: 0 none, 1 the caster-to-target yaw, 2 the reverse, 3 its owner's, 4 the caster's yaw

params.label: Between positions
params.doc: 1: at the midpoint of its owner's position and the previous one

params.label: Spawn tick
params.doc: Its emitter starts when the actor system's tick == this

params.label: Per target
params.doc: 1: an emitter for each target, else one

params.label: Emitter frames
params.doc: Its emitter lives this many frames (its per-frame tables: how many it emits, where)

params.label: Batch
params.doc: Particles a record holds (1..4): what a frame emits, in records of this many

params.label: Spread
params.doc: Where they start round the emitter: 0 on it, 1 a random sphere, 2 a ring (its per-frame radii)

params.label: Exact spread
params.doc: A sphere: 1 at its radii exactly, 0 at random within; a ring: 1 only the height at random

params.label: Kind
params.doc: 0 a flipbook played once, 1 looping, 2 looping some times, 3 nothing, 4 a prim model (its scale and fade tables), 5 a morphing prim model

params.label: Orientation
params.doc: 0 facing the camera with its roll, 1 flat on the ground, 2 the camera's yaw only, 3 / 4 its angles

params.label: Rotation
params.doc: Its angles from: 0 / 1 its owner's matrix (or none), Z X Y / Y X Z; 2 / 3 the camera's, Z X Y / Y X Z

params.label: Turned offsets
params.doc: 1: its offsets turned by its angles

params.label: Depth bias
params.doc: Added to its depth once projected (negative: drawn nearer)

params.label: One-sided
params.doc: Prim models: 0 drawn both sides, 1 its back faces culled

params.label: End
params.doc: A record ends: 0 when its flipbook is done, 1 when its timer runs out, 2 either

params.label: Directions
params.doc: Each particle's direction: 0 Direction with its jitter, 1 the spread's

params.label: Motion
params.doc: 0 physics (speed, velocity, acceleration, gravity), 1 its keyed offsets (its per-frame tables)

params.label: Follows its emitter
params.doc: 1: placed from its emitter every frame, else left behind

params.label: Damping
params.doc: Its speed and velocity lose this / 65536 every frame

params.label: Follow-up
params.doc: 1: when a record ends, an emitter of definition Follow-up definition where it was

tasks.doc: One per target of the action, in turn: follows it; spawns the actor system; releases the master at its tick (the next target's emitter), revives its target from its tick; its sound at its first tick.

The actor system (the act family's, fx_actors.h): from its start tick its set-up (the reference points of the caster and its target) and a step a tick (the actors its data defines: spawned, moved, drawn) until they are all gone after its ticks.
The stage's four fade layers cleared, then their level up a step a tick to its level.
The stage's fade layers from its level down a step a tick to 0.
